sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.settings->'signup'->>'status' AS signup, a.enabled AS ia_ligada, (SELECT count(*) FROM wapi_bot_settings b JOIN wapi_instances w ON w.id = b.instance_id WHERE w.company_id = c.id) AS robos, (SELECT count(*) FROM wapi_instances w WHERE w.company_id = c.id) AS numeros FROM companies c LEFT JOIN ai_agent_settings a ON a.company_id = c.id WHERE c.name ILIKE 'buffet teste%'
